## Lavanda 1.0.2

This release adds full compatibility with current GNOME releases and completes the GTK/libadwaita color definitions.

### GNOME Shell

- Added support for GNOME Shell 48–51.
  - 48–50 use the new `48-0` style branch.
  - 51+ use the new `51-0` branch, including the redesigned login/lock screen, authentication method menu and Web login view.
- Added Web login QR code styling (`.qr-code`).
- Updated quick settings selectors for GNOME 48+ (`.quick-toggle-has-menu`, `.quick-toggle-menu-button`, `.quick-toggle-separator`).
- Added the grouped notification/message list structure (`.message-view`, `.message-notification-group`, `.message-collapse-button`).
- Filled selector gaps for GNOME Shell 40–47: authentication list, screen recording/sharing indicators, calendar events, Looking Glass, message actions and more.

### GTK / libadwaita

- Added the missing libadwaita 1.4+ color variables: `sidebar_*`, `secondary_sidebar_*`, `thumbnail_*`.

### Installation

Download the source archive, extract it, and run:

```sh
./install.sh
```

The script detects the installed GNOME Shell version and compiles the matching styles.
